the-star-spangled-banner.lyrics:
[00:03.78]Oh say, can you see, by the dawn's early light,
[00:12.76]What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming?
[00:21.76]Whose broad stripes and bright stars, thro' the perilous fight,
[00:30.64]O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming?
[00:39.94]And the rocket's red glare, the bombs bursting in air,
[00:49.06]Gave proof thro' the night that our flag was still there.
[00:59.20]Oh, say, does that star-spangled banner yet wave
[01:10.40]O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave?

[00:01.30]O beautiful for pilgrim feet
[00:16.28]Whose stern, impassioned stress
[00:29.50]A thoroughfare for freedom beat
[00:36.66]Across the wilderness!
[00:55.00]America! America!

[01:11.84]Confirm thy soul in self control,
[01:22.28]Thy liberty in law!

air-force-hymn-lord-guar.lyrics:
[00:00.00]Lord, guard and guide the men who fly
[00:07.00]Through the great spaces of the sky;
[00:14.86]Be with them traversing the air
[00:22.00]In dark'ning storms or sunshine fair.

[00:34.60]Thou who dost keep with tender might
[00:41.30]The balanced birds in all their flight,
[00:48.76]Thou of the tempered winds, be near,
[00:55.10]That, having thee, they know no fear.

[01:02.98]Aloft in solitudes of space,
[01:09.38]Uphold them with Thy saving grace.
[01:16.06]O God, protect the men who fly
[01:22.68]Through lonely ways beneath the sky.
[01:32.30]Amen.

eternal-father-strong-to.lyrics:
[00:00.40]Eternal Father, strong to save,
[00:07.38]Whose arm hath bound the restless wave,
[00:15.06]Who bidd'st the mighty ocean deep
[00:21.34]Its own appointed limits keep;
[00:29.60]Oh, hear us when we cry to Thee,
[00:36.98]For those in peril on the sea!
[00:49.20]Amen
